title: New exception on 1.3.0.CR2 with kafka and without reasteasy
body:
**Describe the bug**

On a project using kafka, undertow and vertx web (and not reasteasy), when upgrading from `1.3.0.Alpha1` to `1.3.0.CR2`, in jar mode, this exception is now popping (no problem before):
